notes.title: Round 5 of Additional DLC Available Now!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that starting today, additional downloadable content (DLC) adding new characters and interactions for the action RPG "FAIRY TAIL 2" are available!

[h3][b]New Party Members: Mavis and Zeref[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3193180/FAIRY_TAIL2/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3193190/FAIRY_TAIL2/
The new party members, "Mavis" and "Zeref" are now available to download*. Mavis, the first master of the "Fairy Tail" guild, also known as the "Fairy Tactician", and the Black Wizard Zeref have been added as playable team members! Outside of battle and exploration, you can enjoy new character stories unlocked through “Magic Origin Growth” along with special outfits “Luxury Restaurant,” “Happy Wedding,” and “Fairy School.”

*Note: These characters are already included in the Season Pass. Please avoid making redundant purchases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/5c22ecd4f970c59e4674189d875fe4ab72542459.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/0d9515346ba89eef25df190e1d7c379e3a8d21ce.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Various updates also live![/b][/h3]
In the paid DLC feature "Arena" you can challenge team battles like the "The Dragon King Festival," where you face all members of the "Spriggan 12," as well as Zeref and Acnologia. Additionally, in the free update, new Exchange Quests have been added featuring characters like "Sting", "Rogue", "Ichiya", and "Sherria". Enjoy game-original scenarios and events, such as visiting a haunted house with Frosch and Rogue, or assisting in Sherria's "Magic Class to Learn the Truth of 'Love'."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/414bf0f1d33b8718c522cf53b6dc86d73c19d088.jpg[/img]
Furthermore, as part of the free update, a fourth Origin Core and Tree have been added to the Magic Origins. Once you fully develop all three Origins, you can further enhance your characters' strength. Additionally, the highest difficulty level "FIRED UP!" surpassing "RAGNAROK" has been added, so be sure to "fire up" your passion and take on the challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/77d74491f679d5883e848a84968d55cce2b0410b.jpg[/img]

We are pleased to announce that starting today, December 23rd, 2024, we have released the first round of downloadable content (DLC) that would allow players to enjoy a variety of outfits for the characters for our popular new RPG, "FAIRY TAIL 2"

notes.title: Introducing details about support characters!
notes.content:
In the battles of this title, members of Fairy Tail guild such as Cana and Levy, as well as characters from outside the guild like Jellal, Sting, and Rogue, can join the fight as support characters. By meeting certain conditions during combat, they can help by healing allies or attacking enemies. Additionally, as battles heat up, you can use "Extreme Magic", which significantly impacts both allies and enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/b7714636e7c16292644a552243730462bd08053b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/324efc7da9c56cefbf87de331b5ee1e5a9714a25.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Details about the additional feature for the Digital Deluxe edition: "Atelier Lucy" unveiled![/b][/h3]

This feature is a collaboration between FAIRY TAIL and the alchemy RPG “Atelier” series. In this feature, Lucy uses an alchemy cauldron that suddenly appears in the guild's garden to synthesize more powerful Lacrima using materials collected throughout the Kingdom of Fiore. This content is a must-see for fans of the "Atelier" series.

You can now digitally pre-order FAIRY TAIL 2 in a standard edition, as well as a “FAIRY TAIL 2 Digital Deluxe” edition, which includes the base game, various alternative costumes in collaboration with the Atelier Ryza Secret series, a bonus feature “Atelier Lucy”, as well as various useful in-game items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/a4ed8c3a44a18f30d2b68c12e3995ee515fc1bac.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/4709c31d06ad6e84b4307fd200b0e9d60187aecb.jpg[/img]

[h2][i][b]■ Opening movie live now![/b][/i][/h2]

[previewyoutube=9Cp4jZIBaBM;full][/previewyoutube]

In the newly released opening movie, fans can get a glimpse of the Alvarez Empire Arc events awaiting them in FAIRY TAIL 2. The cinematic introduces players to members of the FAIRY TAIL guild as they battle Emperor Spriggan Zeref, his team of elites, the Spriggan 12, and the Black Dragon Acnologia, while paying homage to famous scenes featured in the original anime and manga series.

[h2][i][b]■ Experience the events happening after the final battle![/b][/i][/h2]
After completing the main twelve chapters, dive into a completely original story, the “Key to the Unknown” and access new exclusive areas! Join the FAIRY TAIL guild as they take on various quests such as finding a hidden gem in a restaurant located in a forest somewhere in the west, determining the midsummer champion at “Akane Beach” in the south, and encountering a variety of unexpected characters.

On 12th December, [i][b]FAIRY TAIL 2[/b][/i] brings fans back to the epic action of the original series’ climax, the Alavarez Empire Arc! For more information, be sure to visit the official website or follow the official X account!

notes.title: New information on the game-original story out now!
notes.content:
After clearing all 12 chapters of the main game, a completely original storyline, “Key to the Unknown”, will unfold, opening new areas that could not be reached in the main game.

From heartwarming to comical themes, all four of its large-volume chapters depict various stories including the procurement of a hidden gem in a restaurant located in a forest somewhere in the west, participating in an event to determine the midsummer champion at “Akane Beach” in the south, and encounters with unexpected characters. Feast your eyes on immersive and memorable places from the anime and manga, as well as a variety of game-original locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/8ff14ef5087d30eae7f2eb233952ecfe246b99db.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/8e4a5f52d13c1e4c95f59b346657df894b2a3f30.png[/img]

[h2]Photo Mode and other rich features![/h2]
We have included the ability to take photos at various points in your journey through the “Photo Mode” feature. Take pictures in memorable locations and line up your favourite characters however you like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066214/f76ad055fdcb29ca3906bb8b55407ecedb81092a.png[/img]

Furthermore, we have added the ability to look back at the final “Alvarez Empire” arc from the original series through various in-game features and events, which can help those who have not played the previous “FAIRY TAIL” game, or are not familiar with the series to fully enjoy this title.

notes.title: FAIRY TAIL 2’S FINAL BATTLE WILL BEGIN ON 11TH DECEMBER, 2024
notes.content:
Today, KOEI TECMO and developer Gust are happy to announce that [i]FAIRY TAIL 2,[/i] their new action RPG based on the popular franchise FAIRY TAIL, will be released on 11th December, 2024.

[h1]First trailer now live![/h1]

[previewyoutube=TnrG9AnM8Rg;full][/previewyoutube]


The newly unveiled trailer gives players a first look at the heroic and speedy magic battles Natsu and the team must unleash in order to defeat their greatest enemy, Zeref, the Emperor Spriggan of the Alvarez Empire. The battles have been completely revamped to reflect the exciting action during combat, and fans will be given the opportunity to use the full scope of the FAIRY TAIL guild members' skills to triumph over their opponents.

In addition to the standard edition, fans can now pre-order the [i][b]“FAIRY TAIL 2 GUILD BOX” [/b][/i]edition, which includes the base game, the visual artbook [i]“Sorcerer Magazine Special Issue: Game Release Edition Vol.2”[/i] inspired by the [i]“Sorcerer Magazine”[/i] as seen in the original work, a Special Shikishi with Holographic Finish (3 types in total), and more. 
*Only available in Europe. See official website for details. 

Fans will also be able to digitally pre-order at a later date the [i][b]“FAIRY TAIL 2 Digital Deluxe Edition”[/b][/i] which will include additional in-game content such as costumes, characters, scenarios, various DLC to enhance the game experience, and more at a later date. More information will be shared soon.

Stay tuned for the latest on [i]FAIRY TAIL 2![/i]


・FAIRY TAIL 2 Official Site
　[url=https://fairytailgame.com/2/]https://fairytailgame.com/2/ [/url]

Based on the manga “FAIRY TAIL” by Hiro Mashima originally serialized in the weekly SHONEN MAGAZINE published by KODANSHA Ltd.
©Hiro Mashima, KODANSHA/FAIRY TAIL Committee, TV TOKYO
©KOEI TECMO GAMES CO., LTD.


*Screens are taken from an in-development build and are not representative of the final product.
